🚀 Strata | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling users to run advanced AI models locally on their personal computers without requiring server infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on consumer hardware • One-click install for Windows/Linux • OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility on localhost • Optional image input support • All processing stays on the user's PC
📖 Summary: Strata is a C++ inference engine that allows users to run the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI model on consumer hardware, such as Windows or Linux PCs with NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards. It provides an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API on localhost and supports optional image input, ensuring all processing remains on the user's machine.
